src/5d/current-manifest.ts.name: Current manifest reader
src/5d/current-manifest.ts.description: Reads today's manifest tags strictly, rejecting repeated or malformed required tags, and collects roles and intents.

src/5d/legacy-manifest.ts.name: Legacy manifest reader
